About The Role
 As a Full-stack Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain modern web applications for a large European public institution. Working across the entire technology stack, you will build user-facing features, scalable backend services, secure APIs, and cloud-based solutions that support critical business operations while ensuring high performance, reliability, and security.
 Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain modern web applications across the full technology stack, including front-end interfaces, backend services, APIs, and database integrations
Create responsive, user-friendly web experiences by implementing intuitive user interactions, optimized layouts, and cross-browser compatible solutions
Build and enhance scalable server-side applications, implementing business logic and integrating with internal and external systems through RESTful APIs and web services
Design, optimize, and maintain relational database structures, ensuring efficient data storage, retrieval, performance, and data integrity
Apply security and data protection best practices, including input validation, authentication, authorization, secure data handling, logging, and monitoring
Troubleshoot, debug, and improve existing applications by analyzing code, identifying performance bottlenecks, and implementing effective solutions
Perform unit and integration testing, validate software changes, and ensure delivered solutions meet both functional and non-functional requirements
Deploy, manage, and support applications in cloud environments using containerization and CI/CD pipelines while maintaining high standards of code quality, documentation, and software architecture
 Requirements
Strong experience with Java, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Hibernate, and the broader Spring ecosystem for developing enterprise-grade applications
Proficiency in front-end technologies including JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and modern frameworks such as Angular
Hands-on experience designing, developing, securing, and consuming RESTful APIs and web services
Solid knowledge of relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL and Oracle, including schema design, query optimization, and data modeling
Experience working with event-driven architectures and asynchronous processing technologies such as Kafka
Familiarity with cloud-based application deployment, containerization technologies, and CI/CD practices
University degree at the Master's level with 5-10 years of professional IT experience, or Bachelor's degree with 7-12 years of relevant experience
Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to analyze complex technical challenges and deliver effective solutions
Good communication and collaboration skills, with English proficiency at B2 level or higher and the ability to work effectively within multicultural, cross-functional teams
